Bill.BriefDescription: Penalizing disruption of traffic by pedestrians.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the disruption of traffic by pedestrians;amending RCW 46.63.020; adding a new section to chapter 46.61 RCW;prescribing penalties; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A pedestrian may not unlawfully and intentionally impede, orotherwise disrupt, the flow of traffic on a highway that has beendesignated, in whole or in part, as a highway of statewidesignificance. (2) A violation of this section is a gross misdemeanor punishableunder RCW 9A.20.021. (3) Nothing in this section prohibits the filing, at any time, ofa cause of action for damages resulting from the disruption of trafficcaused by a pedestrian or pedestrians. (4) In addition to any other costs that may be imposed by thecourt, the court shall require a defendant to reimburse the actual p. 1 ESB 5953costs incurred by a law enforcement agency or emergency personnel, asa result of responding to the traffic disruption prohibited under thissection.
